QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your beginnings to regain your lost memory. Beginnings? When was that? Think about it for a moment.
QuestInfo.1: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your beginnings to regain your lost memory. Beginnings? If it were before when you were forgotten from the world, it would be when you first started my adventure following Freud. However, your current journey began when you heard about Maple World from Tumbleweed. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.2: You visited Tumbleweed at Fox Point Village. He didn't recognize you, as expected, but he told you that everything is just a path to an end. It's true, if a little heavy.

0.0: The beginnings... If it were before when I was forgotten from the world, it would be when I first started my adventure following Freud. But my current journey started when #rTumbleweed#k told me about Maple World, though... he probably won't remember me.
0.1: ...But it makes a good excuse to visit Fox Point Village again. I should go and meet Tumbleweed without being spotted by other foxes.\r\n#r(You will be immediately moved to the Fox Point Village when you accept the quest.)#k

1.0: Hm? Who are you? Ahh, those ears... You're human! How did you get here? Whoaaa, you're a crazy-looking one, you are! If it's not too much to ask, can I sniff you? Oh, don't worry... I won't actually touch you.
1.1: I was thinking of going to Maple World next. I want to pack up and go right away, but I just got back from my last trip. Everyone wants me to stay for an hour or two at least... Sheesh...
1.2: Huh? Have I ever regretted traveling? Of course, I have! Like, I had that moment I really missed my family, you know... But I love traveling. Staying in one place gets so boring! You always should be moving forward, looking for where the road takes you. We're all on that big path, y'know? No sense stopping!
1.3: Hey, are you going already? Well, the people here aren't very welcoming towards outsiders, so I guess that's a good idea. Good luck out there. I hope you find what you're looking for!
